evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rose steadily during growth, from 8.8 to 51.5 ppm by t=3120 (it was about 4-6 ppm during the ramp)
Tube pressure climbed steadily, from 3.04 to 3.44 Torr, while Ar flow held at 100 sccm
MFC reading matches the 100 sccm setpoint, so a stuck MFC is unlikely
Thermocouple is stable at 750 C with steady heater power, so the temperature control looks normal

args.missing_evidence: A leak-up (rate-of-rise) test with the gas off and the tube isolated, or a helium leak check of the flange seals. This would confirm air getting in rather than an exhaust restriction, which would raise pressure but not O2.
